performanceInterpretation.sampleCaution: Small local windows; p95/p99 with n=2 or n=19 often equal an extreme observation and are not robust population estimates. Different activity/route lengths are mixed; no controlled before/after online comparison.
performanceInterpretation.dispatchMeaning: observer-callback to helper entry; publication age also reported. Raw SDK acknowledgement is distinct from observed game effect. Acknowledgement samples can include client path/dialog queries.
performanceInterpretation.idleLimits: Avoidable-idle counter is scheduler-only: approved eligible work, no active helper, and no dispatch. It cannot identify hidden server idleness inside an unresolved SDK promise. helperPendingTicks counts waiting, not productivity; animation alone is not progress. Actual inventory/XP/movement changes are counted separately.
performanceInterpretation.serverClockLimits: Client tick counter is session-relative, not global server phase. Publication revisions can advance within a tick. Network batching affects observed cadence/jitter.
